output_list.criticism: The vulnerability arises from the unchecked addition of balances which can lead to an integer overflow, allowing the owner to mint tokens without any checks on the maximum supply.
output_list.explanation: The function 'mintTokens' does not properly check for overflow when updating the balance of the recipient. This can lead to a significant loss of funds if an attacker can manipulate the input to trigger an overflow, allowing the owner to mint an arbitrary number of tokens.
